field.description: Secure user area address lock bit 0: Unlock the 16 bits in SCR_AREA_END[8:0] and SCR_AREA_START[8:0] in NVMC_OTP_USER_CTL1, the bits can be modified. 1: Lock the 16 bits in SCR_AREA_END[8:0] and SCR_AREA_START[8:0] in NVMC_OTP_USER_CTL1, the bits can not be modified.

field.name: DPLK
field.description: DBGPSWD_DATA lock bit. 0: Unlock DBGPSWD_DATA register, the value of DBGPSWD_DATA can be written. 1: Lock DBGPSWD_DATA register, the value of DBGPSWD_DATA can not be written.

field.name: DUMMY1_LK[7:0]
field.description: DUMMY1[7:0] lock bit 0: Unlock the 8 bits in DUMMY1[7:0], the bits in DUMMY1[7:0] can be modified. 1: Lock the 8 bits in DUMMY1[7:0], the bits in DUMMY1[7:0] can not be modified.

field.name: DUMMY0_LK[7:0]
field.description: DUMMY0[7:0] lock bit 0: Unlock the 8 bits in DUMMY0[7:0], the bits in DUMMY0[7:0] can be modified. 1: Lock the 8 bits in DUMMY0[7:0], the bits in DUMMY0[7:0] can not be modified.
